title: Chapter 250
content:
Chapter 250

Therefore, the class master pondered for a while, and was the first to speak out.

"The kindness of Yuguo, Caomin and the Mohists are very grateful, so naturally they dare not disobey it. As the current giant of the Mohism, Caomin announces that from today onwards, the entire school of the Mohism will be loyal to Yuguo!"

Master Ban's voice was like thunder in the clear sky, which completely awakened Xiaoyaozi and Tian Guang who were still in deep thought, and made them look incredible.

The two people were filled with shock and anger. This old man really couldn't open his eyes. He agreed so early, what should the two of them do?

Following the agreement, the situation in the world is not yet clear, and I don't really want to seek refuge in Yuguo in the north, and the future of following Yuguo is still unknown, so how can I make a decision?

If they don't agree, the two are now at the center of the coalition forces, surrounded by countless troops and masters hiding in the dark. If there is a slight mistake, the body will be decapitated and he will die unexpectedly.

Not to mention, there may be the possibility of suppressing one's own school due to this.

So the two of them could say that they hated Master Ban to death in their hearts. If he didn't speak up and instead chose to advance and retreat with the two of them, then even if Zhong Yu was dissatisfied, after seeing the attitudes of the three of them, he wouldn't be too forceful.

With such a premise, it is very likely that Xiaoyaozi and the others will retreat unscathed and evacuate the camp safely.

Now that such a good situation has been messed up by the traitor Master Ban, how can they not hate it?

However, although Master Ban didn't know what the two of them were thinking, he could still guess it.

But so what? Although the two of them are angry, how can they tolerate their own Mo family?

The three schools of thought are not in true harmony, and there is still competition among them. There are only so many resources in the world, only a few countries, and only a few territories. If you occupy more, I will occupy less.

Therefore, although the three schools have now formed an alliance and seem to have a relatively close relationship, the dirty and petty actions between each other have not stopped in the slightest.

Being in such a competitive relationship, Master Ban thinks he has found a bigger backer, enough to cover him.

No matter how bad it is, under the cover of the power of this backer, the basic territory of the Mohist family in the Yan Kingdom can still be maintained, and it can even penetrate and spread among millions of people like this imperial country with a territory of thousands of miles.

Anyway, Master Ban has not forgotten, according to the news sent back by his Mohist spies in the Imperial Kingdom.

Today's Yuguo has such a vast territory and such a large population, but there is no school that has really formed a scale. The theory is spread in it, like a virgin land, waiting for other schools to open up.

Master Ban agreed so readily and chose to take refuge in Yuguo, and there was no reason why such a piece of cake was placed in front of him and seduced him in a daze.

After all, if the Mohists want to regain their strength now, they must expand their territory and find new resources for development.

But all over the world, the Seven Heroes of the Warring States Period have long been divided up by more or less influential schools, large and small, and there are local snakes everywhere. Where can the Mohists intervene?

Only the north, a country that has just emerged and many local forces have not yet formed, can give the Mohism enough room for development.

As for Xiaoyaozi and Xiaoyaozi, they are now angry and deeply frightened.

They understand that their words and deeds now determine their life and death and the fate of the school, and they are not allowed to do whatever they want.

The current Yu Kingdom, with the support of the Mohist school, already has a banner that can be used to attract forces from all over the world to join them.

Before, the refuge of a single famous figure had already caused many forces in the world to seek refuge in Yuguo. Let Yuguo suddenly increase its strength in terms of the reserves of martial arts masters, not inferior to the Seven Kingdoms.

But now this Mohism, along with Legalism and Confucianism, are known as the three major schools of thought in the world, relying on its mechanism techniques, legalism, and Confucianism have many talents, and together they have the greatest impact on the world.

As for other yin and yang families, peasant families, etc., although they are huge, or have a large number of people, or have outstanding top masters, they are really inferior to these three great schools in terms of influence in the world.

Not to mention Legalism, there is not a single country in the world that does not use Legalists as officials, and its tentacles are all over the world.

And Confucianism should not be underestimated. With the wide opening of the school, nearly one-third of the world's scholars are Confucian scholars. And those who can afford to read, or already know characters, these people are often in charge of public opinion, and have a profound influence on the local area, and the influence of Confucianism is also deeply rooted.

The Mo family, relying on his unique mechanism technique, showed his peerless elegance in the era of wars and turmoil in the world.

No matter it is the six kingdoms of Kanto or Qin itself, you can see the active figures of Mohist disciples. Their excellent defensive mechanism skills are deeply loved by the seven countries in the world.

Regarding the mechanism technique of Mohism, the Six Kingdoms are used to defend against Qin's attack. The Qin State is used to defend against the attacks of the barbarians in the northern border, and the Mohist family is inseparable from anywhere, and because of this, the Mohist family has the ability to influence the world.

As for the other forces, there are more or less unpredictable gaps compared with these three great schools.

Following Master Ban's statement, the two of Xiaoyaozi didn't have enough time.

The foreheads of the two were gradually sweating, and the thoughts in their minds were running fast, trying to find a feasible method.

Not long, probably just a moment, Xiaoyaozi also expressed his opinion.

"Your Highness, my Taoist clan is also willing to raise a faction to surrender, and I hope His Highness will accept it!"

The choice of Xiaoyaozi is not unexpected, the sphere of influence of Taoism is in the land of Han Zhao Wei San Jin.

But now the land of the Three Kingdoms has long been turned into ruins by the flames of war, nearly half of the area is a battlefield, and the local people are empty, displaced, and hungry.

The remaining half, because all the men were conscripted and sent to the front as cannon fodder, fell into the predicament of economic depression and stagnant production. Even in some places, people have starved to death.

In such a miserable situation, Xiaoyaozi still doesn't understand that the potential of these three countries can be said to have been squandered. Without his 40 or 50 years of recuperation, it is impossible to even think about recovering.

Given the current situation in the world, there are still 40 or 50 years for them. These three countries located in the center of the world are bound to become the battlefields and battlegrounds of the surrounding countries, and will fall into even greater chaos.

Being in such a dangerous place, Xiaoyaozi naturally has his own worries, so he runs around looking for allies in an attempt to strengthen the strength of his Taoist clan.

Now facing Yu Guo's solicitation, after thinking about the current situation, he hesitated for a while, and then agreed extremely obediently.
